I called him back and he told me that he will come next day. Again the entire day passed by and no one came.  For me I was losing my patience as everytime he told me someone is coming I use to wait for him.  Finally after calling him again this technician Finally came. Finally by this time I realised that these people are not professionals and for me to take more furniture from them would be disastrous.

Next day I send them a msg that I don't want to buy any more furniture from them seeing their horrible product quality and after sales service.  On getting that msg and fearing that I will cancel the future orders, he immediately send the person to pick up the sofa.

But by this time I had made up my mind not to fall in this trap.  Moreover I read their reviews and it was equally pathetic. I send his person away and informed him that I will repair the sofa somewhere else.

Thank you for your response. However, several statements made in your reply are inaccurate and do not reflect what actually happened.

Therefore, it is incorrect to suggest that the cause of the damage was never explained or assessed.

What is most important is that after this inspection and discussion, there was absolutely no follow-up from your side. No resolution was offered, no repair was proposed, no accountability was accepted, and no effort was made to rectify the damage. Despite multiple calls and follow-ups from us, the matter was simply ignored.

It is also disappointing that your response focuses on defending your position rather than acknowledging the fact that the damage occurred immediately after your installation work and remains unresolved to this day.

Customer reviews, whether positive or negative, are based on genuine experiences and should be accepted constructively. Every business appreciates positive reviews, but professionalism is truly demonstrated when a business takes responsibility for customer concerns and works towards a solution. Unfortunately, in this case, there was more effort spent denying responsibility than resolving the issue.

The facts remain simple: the damage occurred after your installation, your technician inspected the issue, our contractors explained the cause to him over both video and voice calls, and despite repeated follow-ups, no resolution was ever provided.

These people have scammed so many customers. Who knows how many people’s money they've taken like this.
